detail.longDescription: Laying my cards on the table: I'm not an accountant. And I said goodbye to all the bookkeeping tasks associated with my freelance career many moons ago. So what qualifies me to write this article? When I was self-employed, I went through the nightmare of trying to find the right software to help me balance my books (I couldn't afford an accountant).
